name: How long does a yard hydrant repair typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a yard hydrant repair typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a yard hydrant repair depends on the complexity of the problem. Simple repairs, such as replacing a packing washer or a faulty handle, can often be completed within an hour or two. More extensive issues, like replacing a buried frost-proof valve or addressing significant pipe damage, may take longer due to excavation or component availability. CG Plumbing Solutions provides an estimated timeline after assessing the repair's scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies; simple fixes take 1-2 hours, while complex issues might take longer, depending on the problem's scope.
